data.narrative:
Mission Zero Technologies is a Series A climate and energy company founded by Nicholas Chadwick, Shiladitya Ghosh, and Gaël Gobaille-Shaw, having raised £21.8M to date. The sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Lonza Group, LNZA), though the peer set at identical stage and valuation tier remains constrained.

The valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which proves applicable given the company's clear Series A positioning. Using total capital raised (£21.8M) as a proxy baseline and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for progression from Series A to subsequent rounds yields an implied valuation of £44M. Peer-median analysis was not applicable; while the Climate & Energy sector contains nine comparable companies—including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—insufficient datapoints exist at identical stage and valuation tier to generate a reliable narrow peer median.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to the single applicable method, supports a valuation range of £37M (low) to £50M (high), with a median of £44M. The range reflects uncertainty inherent in single-method valuation and the thinness of directly comparable Series A climate-tech transactions. Key uncertainties include capital deployment trajectory, technical milestone achievement, and comparable funding activity in frontier-energy subsectors.
